title: Breakout Duo of the Week (Wk 12): Amareon Blue + Brayden Trimble
parts:
💥 BREAKOUT DUO OF THE WEEK

Two sophomores had the best games of their seasons in Week 12: an Eastern Michigan back who got 27 carries, and an Illinois receiver who went for 121 on 4 catches.

🦅 Amareon Blue, Eastern Michigan RB
🔶 Brayden Trimble, Illinois WR

👇

🦅 Amareon Blue | RB | Eastern Michigan | SO | 3⭐

at Western Michigan: 27 car, 160 yds, 3 TD + 6-16 receiving in a 34-27 L

64% of EMU's carries. Previous 2026 high: 81 yds. 26 carries in his 3 games before it.

#168 RB in the Alpha Draft Signal (preseason #513).

🔶 Brayden Trimble | WR | Illinois | SO | 3⭐

vs Iowa: 4 rec, 121 yds, 1 TD (long 75) in a 34-17 L

38% of Illinois' receiving yds. His previous 2026 high: 57. His 3 games before this one: 4 rec, 35 yds.

#226 WR in the Alpha Draft Signal (preseason #864).

Head to head:

🦅 Blue: 64% of EMU's carries, 5.9 per carry, 3 TD
🔶 Trimble: 38% of Illinois' rec yds, 30.3 per catch, 1 TD

It's one game each. Blue's 2026 best had been 81 yds. 75 of Trimble's 121 came on one catch. Both have to do it again.

Which one would you rather stash in devy right now? 🗳️

🦅 Blue
🔶 Trimble

Next up: Kent State at EMU (Tue Nov 24, 7:00 PM ET), Illinois at Northwestern (Sat Nov 28, 12:30 PM ET).
